threads.body:
Could we replace this new delegating mock test with coverage in `Jms3InstrumentationTest` for `JMSContext.createDurableConsumer`, `createSharedConsumer`, and `createSharedDurableConsumer`, covering the same receive variants? That class already inherits the Artemis container setup from `AbstractJms3Test`, so no new container infrastructure is needed. This would verify the actual provider delegation rather than reproducing it in mocks.

The existing non-delegating mock tests should stay. They verify the simplified-API advice independently, whereas Artemis tests can pass through classic `MessageConsumer` instrumentation.
